mapper.select: SELECT id, email, display_name AS "displayName" FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO app_user s USING (VALUES ( #{id}, #{email}, #{displayName} )) AS v(id, email, display_name) ON s.id = v.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET email = v.email, display_name = v.display_name WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( id, email, display_name ) VALUES ( v.id, v.email, v.display_name )
